name: Mattan
title: The Priest of Baal Who Was Killed
summary: Mattan was a priest of Baal in Judah during the reign of Queen Athaliah. When the priest Jehoiada led the rebellion that restored the rightful Davidic heir Joash to the throne, Mattan was killed before the altar of Baal as part of the religious reform. His death marked the end of the worship of Baal that Athaliah had promoted in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Service as a Priest of Baal under Athaliah
keyEvents.description: Mattan served as a priest of Baal in Jerusalem during the reign of Queen Athaliah, a time when the worship of Baal was promoted in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Jehoiada's Rebellion against Athaliah
keyEvents.description: The priest Jehoiada organized a coup to depose the illegitimate queen Athaliah and restore the young Joash as king over Judah.

keyEvents.title: The Fall and Execution of Athaliah
keyEvents.description: Athaliah was seized and executed at the entrance of the horse gate to the king's palace, paving the way for the destruction of the cult of Baal.

keyEvents.title: Mattan's Death before the Altar of Baal
keyEvents.description: After Athaliah's fall, the people went to Baal's temple, tore it down, smashed the altars and images, and killed Mattan, the priest of Baal, in front of the altars.

keyEvents.title: Restoration of the Lord's Temple Service
keyEvents.description: After Mattan's death and the destruction of Baal's temple, Jehoiada restored the order for service in the Lord's temple as David had established.
